questions.question: The perimeter of a rectangular field is 32 metres and its sides are in the ratio 5 : 3. Then the sides of the field are:
questions.solution:
**Given **

The perimeter of rectangular field = 32 m

**Formula Used **

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

**Calculation **

⇒ let the length and breadth be 5a and 3a respectively 

⇒ 32 = 2(5a + 3a) 

⇒ 16 = 8a 

⇒ a = 2 

⇒ so, length = 5 × 2 = 10 m, breadth = 3 × 2 = 6 m

∴ the length and breadth of rectangle is 10 m and 6 m respectively

The given bar graph represents the number of students who appeared in the board examination in session 2017 - 18 and 2018-19. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c99749de0d4e177b40e75da1f7ebf0febc518047c33bfd875714c91f47c8e78a.png] 

The difference between the average number of students of Science and Mathematics streams in 2017-2018 and that in Commerce and Vocational in 2018-19 is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

From the graph, 

No of science student in 2017 - 2018 = 25

No of Mathematics student in 2017 - 2018 = 53

No of commerce student in 2018 - 2019 = 48

No of Vocational student in 2018 - 2019 = 38

**Formula Used **

Average = sum of observation/No. of observation

**Calculation**

&rArr
; Sum of no. of science and Mathematics student in 2017 - 2018 = 25 + 53 = 78

⇒ Sum of no. of commerce and vocational student in 2018 - 2019 = 48 + 38 = 86

⇒ Difference = 86 - 78 = 8 

⇒ Average = 8/2 = 4 

∴ the difference between the average no. of student is 4

questions.question: Anu purchased a car and then sold it. If the ratio of the cost price and selling price is 10 : 11, then the profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Ratio of cost price and selling price = 10 : 11 

**Formula Used **

Profit% = (profit/cp) × 100

Profit = sp - cp 

**Calculation **

⇒ let the cost price and selling price be 10x ad 11x 

⇒ Profit = 11x - 10x = x 

⇒ Profit % = (x/10x) × 100 = 10%

questions.question: Ravi and Mohan together can complete a task in 3 days. Ravi alone can complete the same task in 7 days. How many days will Mohan alone take to complete the same task?
questions.solution:
**Given **

Ravi and Mohan can complete work = 3 days

Ravi alone complete the work = 7 days

**Formula Used**

Work = time × efficiency 

**Calculation**

⇒ LCM of (3, 7) = 21

⇒ Let the total work be 21

⇒ Efficiency of Ravi and Mohan together = 21/3 = 7

⇒ Efficiency of Ravi alone = 21/7 = 3

⇒ Efficiency of Mohan = 7 - 3 = 4 

⇒ Mohan takes time to complete the work alone = 21/4 = 5(1)/(4) days

The difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on a sum of Rs. 8,000 for 2 years at the rate of 5% p.a. is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Principal = Rs 8000 

Time = 2 years 

Rate of interest = 5% 

**Formula Used **

Simple interest = Principal × rate × time/100

Compound interest = principal[(1 + r/100)t - 1)

**Calculation**

⇒ simple interest = (8000 × 2 × 5)/100 = Rs 800

⇒ compound interest = 8000[(1 + 1/20)² - 1] = 8000 × 41/400 = Rs 820

⇒ the difference between simple interest and compound interest = Rs 820 - Rs 800 = Rs 20

questions.question: The marked price of a book is Rs. 540. After 10% discount on the marked price, the selling price of the book is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Marked price of a books = Rs 540 

**Formula Used **

Discount = Marked price - selling price 

Discount % =(discount/marked) × 100 

**Calculation **

⇒ 10% = (Discount/540) × 100 

⇒ Discount = 54 

⇒ Selling price = Marked price - discount 

⇒ SP = 540 - 54 = Rs 486 

∴ The selling price of books is Rs 486

questions.question: Abhi finishes a journey by car in 9 hours. He travels the first half of the journey at a speed 40 km/h and the second half of the journey at a speed of 50 km/h. The total distance covered is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

Abhi takes time = 9 hrs

**Formula Used **

Time = Distance/speed 

**Calculation **

Let the distance be covered by Abhi be 2x 

⇒ 9 hrs = (x/40) + (x/50)

⇒ x = (9 × 2000)/90 

⇒ x = 200 km 

∴ the total distance covered by Abhi = 2x = 400 km

questions.question: If the number 62783 xy is divisible by both 8 and 5, then the smallest possible value of x and y is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **divisibility by 5**, the last digit **y** must be either 0 or 5.

Since the number is also **divisible by 8**, it must be **even**, which eliminates **y = 5**; therefore, **y = 0**.

For **divisibility by 8**, the last three digits **3x0** must be divisible by 8.

Testing the smallest values: **300** ÷ 8 (No), **310** ÷ 8 (No), **320** ÷ 8 = 40 (Yes).

Smallest pair is **x = 2** and **y = 0**.

**∴ The correct answer is x = 2, y = 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The number **62783xy** is divisible by both **8** and **5**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/759ec53e1174eebd7ff37364990dc10d59fcf9fbda16bfcc01f49392418d2fe6.png] 

**Condition for Divisibility by 5:**

⇒ The last digit **y** must be **0** or **5**.

**Condition for Divisibility by 8:**

⇒ The last three digits **3xy** must be divisible by **8**.

⇒ If **y = 5**, the number **3x5** is odd. An odd number is never divisible by 8.

⇒ Thus, **y = 0** is the only possibility.

**Finding the smallest x for 3x0:**

⇒ If **x = 0**, 300 ÷ 8 = 37.5 (Not divisible)

⇒ If **x = 1**, 310 ÷ 8 = 38.75 (Not divisible)

⇒ If **x = 2**, 320 ÷ 8 = 40 (**Divisible**)

⇒ Comparing values, the smallest values are **x = 2** and **y = 0**.

**∴ The correct answer is x = 2, y = 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its **last three digits** is divisible by 8 or if the last three digits are 000.

Divisibility Rule of 5

A number is divisible by 5 if its **units digit** is either 0 or 5.

Divisibility by 40

Since 40 = 5 × 8 (and they are co-prime), any number divisible by both 5 and 8 is also **divisible by 40**.

Parity Rule for Divisibility

Any number divisible by an **even number** (like 2, 4, 6, 8, etc.) must itself be an **even number**.</p

questions.question: The average of the ages of Sonu, Hari and Govind is 30 years. If their ages are in the ratio of 4 : 5: 6 respectively, then the difference between the ages of Sonu and Govind is:
questions.solution:
**Given **

The average age of Sonu, Hari and Govind = 30 years

**Formula Used **

Average = Sum of observation/No. of observation

**Calculation**

⇒ Sum of age = 30 × 3 = 90 

⇒ let the age of Sonu, Hari and Govind be 4x, 5x and 6x 

⇒ 4x + 5x + 6x = 90 

⇒ 15x = 90 

⇒ x = 6 

⇒ Difference between the ages of Sonu and Govind = 6x - 4x 

⇒ 2x = 2 × 6 = 12 years 

∴ the difference between the ages of Sonu and Govind is 12 years

questions.question: In a circle centered at O, a tangent AP is drawn from an external point. If OA = 13 cm and OP = 5cm, then the length of tangent AP is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/574d8d98e437b34e8f10954b2d59920bd79116422601e314e65a61ca4a00a658.png] 

**Given **

OA = 13 cm 

OP = 5cm 

**Formula Used **

(Hypotnuese)² = (Perpendicular)² + (Base)²

**Calculation **

We know that, tangent makes right angle with center of circle 

⇒ ΔOPA is right angle triangle, ∠OPA = 90° 

⇒ (Hypotnuese)2 = (Perpendicular)2 + (Base)2

⇒ (OA)² = (AP)² + (OP)²

⇒ 13² = AP² + 5² 

⇒ AP = 12 cm
